name: keymap

test_list.description: Every Action is bound at least once or listed in UNBOUND with a reason; nothing is both.
No action in UNBOUND appears in the binding table.
No (context, trigger, guard) triple occurs twice in the table.
footer_text builds the footer from the table: each hint is the first chord of the action plus its label.
Feeding a modified table to footer_text changes the footer, proving the string is generated not stored.
help_lines mentions every bound chord of every binding.
Enter submits; Shift+Enter, Alt+Enter and Ctrl+J insert a newline; Ctrl+Enter is intentionally unbound. Other table rows resolve to their stated action.
History keys need the first/last-row guard, ? needs an empty draft, popup contexts fall back to Popup and Global.
Chords render as Ctrl+O, Shift+Enter, Esc, F2, ?, P.
Shift is dropped for character keys and letters compare case-insensitively.
Wheel, drag, double-click, tool-title click and To-latest click have bindings.
Any chord in any context and guard state resolves to Some or None without panicking.
Questionnaire contexts isolate the specified answer navigation, notes, atomic submit, interrupt requester and defer controls from global shortcuts.

inputs.name: state
inputs.description: Draft empty / first row / last row.

output_description: The keymap as data plus generated footer and help text.
